name: Mote of Mercy, Turn the Edge

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 1; this prevents harm rather than healing any injury.

surges.html: The target resists 1 unit of forced movement from that Action.
